interface.longDescription: Connect your Apartman Yönetimi account to your conversation. Apartment and residential community managers can review their buildings, residents, dues, recorded payments, meetings, decisions, maintenance requests, surveys and documents. Changes are prepared for review and take effect only after approval in the Apartman Yönetimi app. An existing Apartman Yönetimi account and manager permissions are required. Each user can access only records authorized for their own account. Payment tools prepare bookkeeping entries; they do not transfer money.
